exercise_name: Set Fire To The Rain · Listening & Vocabulary
description: 《Set Fire to the Rain》描寫一段從深愛與信任，逐漸走向欺騙、心碎與決裂的愛情。歌中的主角曾經將自己的心交給對方，相信他的出現拯救了自己，卻慢慢發現他隱藏著不為人知的一面，曾經的承諾與甜言蜜語原來充滿謊言。即使她仍然眷戀過去的美好時光，也明白這段感情已經無法繼續。歌曲中的「點燃雨水」象徵悲傷與憤怒交織，以及決心結束這段關係的勇氣。最終，《Set Fire to the Rain》傳達的是愛情中的背叛、痛苦與放手：即使理智知道必須離開，內心仍可能充滿思念，但唯有勇敢面對傷痛，才能逐漸走出過去，重新找回自己。

vocabulary.usage: 當手上的東西落下，或讓東西掉下去時使用。常用句型：let + 東西 + fall。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Let something fall」？
options: I let the apple fall from my hand.
I let my breakfast fall in the morning to eat it.
She let the music fall because she wanted to hear it.
We let the bus fall to school every day.
optionExplanations: 正確：蘋果從手中掉下來，符合 let + 物品 + fall。
錯誤：吃早餐不是讓早餐掉下來；應說 I eat breakfast in the morning。
錯誤：想聽音樂不會用 fall；應說 She played the music。
錯誤：搭公車不能用 let ... fall；應說 We take the bus to school。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：蘋果從手中掉下來，符合 let + 物品 + fall。

vocabulary.meaning: 救某人；幫助某人脫離危險。
vocabulary.usage: 有人遇到危險，需要其他人幫助時可以使用；也可說 save someone from + 危險。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Save someone」？
options: She saved her homework with a sandwich.
The boy saved his friend from the cold river.
I saved my shoes to the cinema last night.
He saved his lunch by singing to it.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：三明治不能用來「救」作業；若是完成作業，可說 She finished her homework。
正確：朋友遇到危險，男孩把他救起來。
錯誤：去電影院不是 save 的意思；應說 I wore my shoes to the cinema。
錯誤：唱歌給午餐聽不是正常的救援情境；可以說 He ate his lunch。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：朋友遇到危險，男孩把他救起來。

vocabulary.usage: 想強調某事超過適當程度時使用，後面常接形容詞，例如 far too hot。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Far too」？
options: My dog is far too on the sofa.
I far too my bag before school.
This box is far too heavy for me to carry.
She has far too three sisters.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：far too 後面不能直接接 on the sofa；可說 My dog is far too big for the sofa。
錯誤：far too 不是動詞，不能表示整理書包；應說 I pack my bag。
正確：far too heavy 強調箱子重得過頭。
錯誤：far too 不能直接放在數字前；要說 She has three sisters。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：far too heavy 強調箱子重得過頭。

vocabulary.meaning: 某人性格中的一面；某人不容易被看見的特質。
vocabulary.usage: 發現朋友或家人有不同的個性或表現時使用，常說 a different side to someone。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「A side to someone」？
options: I saw a funny side to my quiet friend today.
I put a side to my brother on the table.
We ate a side to our teacher for lunch.
She drove a side to her friend to school.
optionExplanations: 正確：原本安靜的朋友展現出幽默的一面。
錯誤：這個片語不是可以放到桌上的東西；要放東西可說 I put a book on the table。
錯誤：個性的一面不是食物；可說 We ate lunch with our teacher。
錯誤：這個片語不能表示開車載人；可說 She drove her friend to school。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：原本安靜的朋友展現出幽默的一面。

vocabulary.usage: 想表示一句話、消息或故事是真的時使用；常說 It is true 或 That is not true。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Be true」？
options: The story is true. It really happened.
I am true my homework after dinner.
She trued her bike to the park.
The soup is true because it is hot.
optionExplanations: 正確：故事真的發生過，因此可以用 true。
錯誤：true 不是「做」的動詞；應說 I do my homework。
錯誤：true 不能當作一般動詞表示騎車；應說 She rode her bike。
錯誤：熱度不能用 true 描述；應說 The soup is hot。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：故事真的發生過，因此可以用 true。

vocabulary.usage: 談到火把東西燒起來時使用，結構是 set fire to + 物品；歌曲將它用在不可能燃燒的雨上，是比喻。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Set fire to」？
options: He set fire to his sandwich by eating it.
I set fire to the bus because I was late.
Someone set fire to the old house, and it burned.
She set fire to her homework with a pencil.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：吃三明治不是點火；應說 He ate his sandwich。
錯誤：遲到時搭車不叫點火；應說 I took the bus。
正確：房子被人放火燒了，符合 set fire to。
錯誤：用鉛筆寫作業不是點火；應說 She did her homework with a pencil。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：房子被人放火燒了，符合 set fire to。

vocabulary.usage: 倒水、牛奶等液體時可用 pour；雨下很大時可以說 It is pouring。
options: I poured my shoes onto my feet.
We poured the door before going out.
She poured a song into her phone to call me.
It is pouring outside, so take an umbrella.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：鞋子不是液體；應說 I put on my shoes。
錯誤：門不是液體；應說 We opened the door。
錯誤：歌曲不能像水一樣用 pour 來表示打電話；應說 She called me。
正確：It is pouring 表示外面正在下大雨。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：It is pouring 表示外面正在下大雨。

vocabulary.meaning: 最後一次；上一次（要看上下文）。
vocabulary.usage: 談某件事最後一次發生，或回想上一次做某件事時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「The last time」？
options: The last time is very hungry now.
The last time I saw him was on Monday.
I put the last time in my school bag.
She cooked the last time for breakfast.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：the last time 不是人，不能肚子餓；可說 I am very hungry now。
正確：用來說明上一次見到他是在星期一。
錯誤：時間不是可以放進書包的物品；可說 I put my book in my bag。
錯誤：the last time 不是早餐食物；可說 She cooked eggs for breakfast。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：用來說明上一次見到他是在星期一。

vocabulary.usage: 用來說明電影、比賽、課程或感情關係已經結束。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Be over」？
options: I am over my sandwich for lunch.
The cat is over because it is black.
We over our books every evening.
The game is over. We can go home now.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：be over 不能直接表示吃午餐；應說 I am eating my sandwich。
錯誤：顏色與「結束」無關；應說 The cat is black。
錯誤：over 在這裡不能直接當動詞；應說 We read our books。
正確：比賽結束了，所以可以回家。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：比賽結束了，所以可以回家。

vocabulary.meaning: 忍不住做某事；無法控制自己不去做。
vocabulary.usage: 當你明明想停下，卻忍不住笑、哭或看某個東西時使用。help 後面的動詞要加 -ing。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Can't help + -ing」？
options: I can't help laugh when I see that funny dog.
I can't help laughing when my dog wears my hat.
She can't help to crying at the movie.
We can't help our dancing when we hear music.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：這個句型要用動詞 -ing；應說 I can’t help laughing。
正確：忍不住笑，且 help 後接 laughing。
錯誤：不能用 to crying；應說 She can’t help crying。
錯誤：這裡不需要 our；應說 We can’t help dancing。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：忍不住笑，且 help 後接 laughing。

audioAlignment.reviewStatus: Conservative automatic cues; uncertain background or unmatched lines remain visible without guessed timing.

advanced.title: 進階字彙
advanced.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 聲稱；認領；主張擁有
questions.usage: 正式申請物品、提出主張時常用 claim；歌中有「取得、據為己有」的詩意用法。
options: He claimed the soup because he wanted it warmer.
The school claimed the rain to its front gate.
Our teacher claimed the lights by switching them off.
Mia claimed her lost bag at the station desk.
optionExplanations: claim 不能表示把湯加熱，應用 heated。
claim 不能表示把雨搬到校門口；此處無合理的認領或聲稱用法。
claim 不是關燈，應用 switched off。
正確：claim a lost bag 表示憑所有權把遺失的包包領回。
questions.explanation: 正確：claim a lost bag 表示憑所有權把遺失的包包領回。

questions.meaning: 升起；起身（rise 的過去式）
questions.usage: 描述人站起、太陽升起或某物向上移動；rise 通常不直接帶受詞。
options: She rose a photo for the school newspaper.
They rose the meeting until Monday morning.
The singer rose from her chair when the show ended.
The boy rose his suitcase onto the high shelf.
optionExplanations: 拍照片應用 took，不能說 rose a photo。
會議延期應用 moved 或 postponed。
正確：rose from her chair 表示從椅子上站起。
搬起行李應用 lifted；rose 不是及物動詞。
questions.explanation: 正確：rose from her chair 表示從椅子上站起。

questions.meaning: 膝蓋（knee 的複數）
questions.usage: 談到跪下、膝蓋受傷，或腿部無力時使用；不要與 feet 混淆。
options: The train hurt its knees as it entered town.
The singer bent her knees before the high jump.
He washed his knees because his glasses were dirty.
My knees were hungry after our family lunch.
optionExplanations: 火車沒有人的膝蓋，這裡不能當身體部位。
正確：跳高前彎曲膝蓋，身體動作合理。
眼鏡髒與洗膝蓋沒有合理關係。
膝蓋不會肚子餓；是人感到 hungry。
questions.explanation: 正確：跳高前彎曲膝蓋，身體動作合理。

questions.meaning: 站立；承受、忍受
questions.usage: 可指站起或保持站立；也能說 cannot stand + 名詞／-ing 表示無法忍受。
options: He stood his bicycle to the cinema yesterday.
My sister cannot stand loud noise while studying.
I stand the music on the bus every morning.
The waiter stood the soup until it was ready.
optionExplanations: 騎車應說 rode his bicycle。
正確：cannot stand loud noise 是無法忍受吵鬧聲。
stand 不能直接表示播放音樂；可說 play music。
stand 不是加熱或端湯的動詞。
questions.explanation: 正確：cannot stand loud noise 是無法忍受吵鬧聲。

questions.meaning: 觸碰；使感動（touch 的過去式）
questions.usage: 描述實際碰觸，也能說 be touched by + 人／事，表示受到感動。
options: The speech touched everyone with its kind message.
We touched the weather to keep it sunny.
I touched the bus ticket into my schoolbag.
The map touched the village because it was accurate.
optionExplanations: 正確：演講內容使大家感動，touch 可表情感上的觸動。
人無法透過 touch 操控天氣。
把車票放進包包應用 put。
地圖準確並不代表它觸動村莊；此處應用 showed。
questions.explanation: 正確：演講內容使大家感動，touch 可表情感上的觸動。

questions.meaning: 燃燒；燒傷（burn 的過去式）
questions.usage: 可形容物品燃燒，或人被燙傷；比喻上也可說感到強烈情緒。
options: She burned the bus by missing it after school.
The cold drink burned his room into a larger place.
The chair burned its homework before the school bell.
The cook burned the rice because the heat was too high.
optionExplanations: 錯過公車應說 missed the bus。
冷飲不會把房間變大，且 burn 不表示變大。
椅子不會做功課，不能如此使用 burned。
正確：火太大導致米飯燒焦。
questions.explanation: 正確：火太大導致米飯燒焦。

questions.meaning: 大聲喊出；尖叫著喊
questions.usage: 表示用很大的聲音喊出話語；通常帶有強烈情緒。
options: The fridge screamed out dinner by keeping milk cold.
Our team screamed out the train at six o’clock.
The coach was screaming out the scores over the crowd.
I screamed out my shoes before leaving the house.
optionExplanations: 冰箱冷藏牛奶不是喊叫或說出內容。
這句無法表示搭火車或喊出可理解內容。
正確：教練隔著人群大聲喊出比分。
穿鞋應用 put on，不能用 screamed out。
questions.explanation: 正確：教練隔著人群大聲喊出比分。

questions.meaning: 躺著（lie 的過去式；此處為不及物）
questions.usage: 原歌詞 When I lay with you 使用 lie 的過去式 lay；與 lay a book（放下書）的現在式不同。
options: Yesterday, I lay on the sofa and read a book.
The children lay their coats on the bed yesterday.
I lay the tickets on the desk before class yesterday.
Yesterday, I lay the book on the shelf and left.
optionExplanations: 正確：lay on the sofa 是 lie（躺）的過去式。
放置外套的過去式應用 laid，而非 lay。
放票的過去式應用 laid；本題指定「躺」。
此處 lay 是「放置」動詞，且昨天需用 laid；不是本題要考的「躺」。
questions.explanation: 正確：lay on the sofa 是 lie（躺）的過去式。

questions.meaning: 火焰（flame 的複數）
questions.usage: 描寫實際燃燒的火焰；也可比喻熱情，但日常更常描述火勢。
options: The driver checked the flames to find his bus route.
The flames grew higher as the dry wood burned.
The singer wore flames to hear the song better.
Her notebook had three flames to write with in class.
optionExplanations: 找公車路線應查 map，flames 是火焰。
正確：乾木燃燒，火焰越升越高。
火焰不是協助聽音樂的設備。
寫字需要 pens，flames 不是書寫工具。
questions.explanation: 正確：乾木燃燒，火焰越升越高。

questions.meaning: 投擲；扔出（throw 的過去式）
questions.usage: throw—threw—thrown；可用 throw something into / across + 地點。
options: The teacher threw a question because it was blue.
We threw the train at the station before noon.
She threw her music louder with the new speaker.
He threw his jacket across the chair after work.
optionExplanations: 提問應用 asked，不是 threw a question；顏色也不構成理由。
搭上火車應用 boarded 或 caught。
調大音樂應用 turned up。
正確：把外套扔到椅子上，符合 throw 的過去式。
questions.explanation: 正確：把外套扔到椅子上，符合 throw 的過去式。

questions.meaning: 接住；抓到（catch 的過去式）
questions.usage: 可指接住球、抓住物品，也可說 catch a bus 表示趕上公車。
options: The river caught a postcard and wrote a letter.
The cook caught the soup until it tasted sweet.
My friend caught the ball before it hit the window.
We caught the classroom to clean it after lunch.
optionExplanations: 河流不會寫信；這不符合 catch 的常用意思。
調整湯的味道應用 tasted 或 cooked。
正確：在球碰到窗戶前把球接住。
打掃教室不是 catch the classroom。
questions.explanation: 正確：在球碰到窗戶前把球接住。

questions.meaning: 想必是；一定是（根據線索推測）
questions.usage: must be + 名詞／形容詞／-ing，表示說話者根據證據做高度確信的推測。
options: Her coat is wet, so it must be raining outside.
The cake must be ate since the plate is empty.
He must be to school because his bag is heavy.
The door must be opens because the room is bright.
optionExplanations: 正確：外套濕了，推測外面一定正在下雨。
被動式應用 must have been eaten，不是 must be ate。
要表示在學校應用 must be at school。
must be 後應用 open（形容詞），不是 opens。
questions.explanation: 正確：外套濕了，推測外面一定正在下雨。

questions.meaning: 即使到現在；至今仍然
questions.usage: 強調一件事在經過一段時間後仍然如此，通常與仍持續的感受或狀態搭配。
options: Even now, I still remember my first day at school.
He even now his bag before leaving for the airport.
Even now means I will travel only next Tuesday morning.
Even now, yesterday will begin again tomorrow evening.
optionExplanations: 正確：即使過了很久，仍記得第一天上學。
even now 是副詞片語，不能當整理包包的動詞。
even now 不是「下週二」的專屬時間詞。
昨天不能再次開始；時間邏輯不通。
questions.explanation: 正確：即使過了很久，仍記得第一天上學。

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.word: let + 受詞 + 原形動詞
questions.meaning: ｜讓某物掉落；let 後的動詞不用 to。
questions.usage: ｜想表達允許或任由某事發生。
questions.prompt: 魔術師想讓羽毛自然落到桌上，哪句最自然？
options: I let the feather falling on the table.
I let the feather fell on the table.
I let the feather fall on the table.
I let the feather to fall on the table.
optionExplanations: 這個結構不直接接 falling。
let 後不可用過去式 fell。
正確：let + 受詞 + 原形 fall。
let 後不用 to fall。
questions.explanation: 正確：let + 受詞 + 原形 fall。

questions.word: as + 子句：兩件事同時發生
questions.meaning: ｜當它落下的同時；as 可連接同步發生的動作。
questions.usage: ｜描述一邊發生 A，一邊發生 B。
questions.prompt: 小女孩揮手時，火車正離開，選正確句。
options: As the train left, she waved goodbye.
As left the train, she waved goodbye.
As the train leaving, she waved goodbye.
As the train to leave, she waved goodbye.
optionExplanations: 正確：as 後接有主詞和動詞的子句。
英語一般須說 the train left。
缺少 was，不能只用 leaving。
to leave 不構成完整子句。
questions.explanation: 正確：as 後接有主詞和動詞的子句。

questions.meaning: ｜rose 是 rise 的過去式；後接 to 表示隨後想做的事。
questions.usage: ｜有人站起來發言、拿東西或幫忙時。
questions.prompt: 會議中，一位女士站起來回答問題。
options: She rose to answer the question.
She rose for answer the question.
optionExplanations: 正確：rose to answer，站起來回答。
for 後不能直接接原形 answer。
rose 後不能直接用 answering 表目的。
這裡缺少表目的的 to。
questions.explanation: 正確：rose to answer，站起來回答。

questions.word: until + 子句：直到某個時刻
questions.meaning: ｜直到某事發生為止；until 引出時間界線。
questions.usage: ｜解釋一件事一直持續到另一事件發生。
questions.prompt: 房間一直很安靜，直到鐘響。
options: The room was quiet until rang the bell.
The room was quiet until to ring the bell.
The room was quiet until the bell rang.
The room was quiet until the bell ringing.
optionExplanations: until 後的子句語序不對。
until 後不可直接用 to ring 作子句。
正確：until + the bell rang。
缺少 be 動詞，ringing 不成完整子句。
questions.explanation: 正確：until + the bell rang。

questions.word: 主題先提出：名詞 + 代名詞重提
questions.meaning: ｜先提出談論對象，再用 they 重提；常見於口語與歌詞。
questions.usage: ｜強調一個主題；正式寫作通常直接用該名詞作主詞。
questions.prompt: 想用相同的口語強調方式說「那些山，它們很高」。
optionExplanations: 複數名詞不能對應單數 it was。
正確：複數 mountains 對應 they were；屬口語重提。
缺少 were。
變成倒裝疑問句，不是此處的陳述。
questions.explanation: 正確：複數 mountains 對應 they were；屬口語重提。

questions.word: far too + 形容詞：強調過度
questions.meaning: ｜「遠遠太……」；far 加強 too 的過度程度。
questions.usage: ｜描述明顯超過可接受程度的狀態。
questions.prompt: 這座橋太窄，大車不能通過。
options: The bridge is far too narrow for a big truck.
The bridge is far narrow too for a big truck.
The bridge is far too narrowly for a big truck.
The bridge far too narrow for a big truck.
optionExplanations: 正確：is far too narrow。
far too 的順序不可顛倒。
narrowly 是副詞，不適合作表語形容詞。
缺少 is。
questions.explanation: 正確：is far too narrow。

questions.meaning: ｜太……以致無法做某事；形容詞與 to 可跨歌詞行。
questions.usage: ｜描述能力或條件不足以完成某行動。
questions.prompt: 孩子太矮，碰不到高架子。
options: The child is too short for touch the shelf.
The child is too short touch the shelf.
The child is too short to touch the shelf.
The child is too short touching the shelf.
optionExplanations: for 後不能直接接原形 touch。
缺少 to。
正確：too short to touch。
這裡需用 to-infinitive 表結果。
questions.explanation: 正確：too short to touch。

questions.meaning: ｜不做某事；介系詞 without 後可接動名詞。
questions.usage: ｜描述完成某事而沒有發生另一件事。
questions.prompt: 舞者完成整場表演，沒有跌倒。
options: The dancer finished without to fall.
optionExplanations: 不能接過去式 fell。
正確：without falling。
without 不接 to-infinitive。
介系詞後不可直接用原形 fall。
questions.explanation: 正確：without falling。

questions.word: there is + 名詞：引入新資訊
questions.meaning: ｜介紹某個存在的事物；there 並非地點副詞。
questions.usage: ｜初次提出某個特徵、問題或事物。
questions.prompt: 咖啡店旁有一座小花園。
options: There a small garden is next to the café.
There are a small garden next to the café.
There have a small garden next to the café.
There is a small garden next to the café.
optionExplanations: 此存在句的標準語序錯誤。
單數 a garden 不配 are。
there have 不能代替 there is。
正確：單數 a garden 用 there is。
questions.explanation: 正確：單數 a garden 用 there is。

questions.word: 受詞關係子句：省略 that
questions.meaning: ｜that 引出修飾名詞的關係子句；作受詞時常可省略。
questions.usage: ｜補充「哪一個人／物」的資訊。
questions.prompt: 畫家展示一幅她去年完成的畫。
options: She showed a picture which painted she last year.
She showed a picture which she painting last year.
She showed a picture which did she paint last year.
She showed a picture which she painted last year.
optionExplanations: 關係子句主詞動詞位置錯。
painting 前缺少助動詞。
關係子句通常不用疑問倒裝 did she。
正確：which 是 painted 的受詞，可替換成 that 或省略。
questions.cue:
a side to you
That I never knew
questions.explanation: 正確：which 是 painted 的受詞，可替換成 that 或省略。

questions.word: would + 原形：回憶反覆的習慣
questions.meaning: ｜描述過去反覆發生的習慣，不一定表示現在或未來。
questions.usage: ｜回想某人以前總會做的事。
questions.prompt: 回憶小時候，奶奶每個週日都烤麵包。
options: Grandma would always baked bread on Sundays.
Grandma would always to bake bread on Sundays.
Grandma would always bake bread on Sundays.
Grandma would always baking bread on Sundays.
optionExplanations: would 後需原形，不是 baked。
would 後不加 to。
正確：would always bake，描述以往習慣。
would 後不用 baking。
questions.explanation: 正確：would always bake，描述以往習慣。

questions.meaning: ｜「點燃……」；原歌將無法真正燃燒的雨當作比喻。
questions.usage: ｜談歌曲意象時，分清字面事件與比喻；不需模仿真實危險行為。
questions.prompt: 哪句正確解釋原歌中不可能真的發生的畫面？
options: The singer is describing a real way to burn rain.
The singer tells us that rain is made of paper.
The singer uses fire and rain to show strong feelings.
The singer says that rain always starts fires.
optionExplanations: 歌詞不是提供真實操作方式。
雨不是紙做的；原歌沒有這樣說。
正確：火與雨構成情緒上的超現實比喻。
並非主張雨總會引起火災。
questions.explanation: 正確：火與雨構成情緒上的超現實比喻。

questions.word: watch + 受詞 + 原形：觀看完整動作
questions.meaning: ｜看見某個動作發生；watch 後接受詞與原形動詞。
questions.usage: ｜描述親眼看見一件事發生。
options: The child watched the plane landed.
The child watched the plane land.
The child watched the plane landing down.
The child watched the plane to land.
optionExplanations: 不可在此處直接用過去式 landed。
正確：watched + plane + land。
landing 也可能合文法，但此選項多餘的 down 不自然，且重點是完整降落動作。
watch + object 後不接 to。
questions.explanation: 正確：watched + plane + land。

questions.word: as + 過去式子句：同步背景
questions.meaning: ｜一邊……一邊……；這裡 as 帶出同時發生的背景。
questions.usage: ｜描述事情同時發生，而不是因為某事。
questions.prompt: 燈亮起的同時，演員走上舞台。
options: As came on the lights, the actor walked on stage.
As the lights to come on, the actor walked on stage.
As the lights coming on, the actor walked on stage.
As the lights came on, the actor walked on stage.
optionExplanations: 一般陳述子句不倒裝。
to come on 不成完整子句。
coming on 不成完整子句。
正確：完整過去式子句作時間背景。
questions.explanation: 正確：完整過去式子句作時間背景。

questions.meaning: ｜「當……期間」；可描寫兩件同時持續的事情。
questions.usage: ｜敘述某個動作發生時另一動作正在進行。
questions.prompt: 雨下著的時候，他們待在室內。
options: They stayed inside while to rain.
They stayed inside while it rained.
They stayed inside while the rain.
optionExplanations: 省掉主詞會造成不清楚的省略結構。
while 後不能直接接 to-infinitive。
正確：while it rained。
the rain 是名詞片語，不是完整子句。
questions.explanation: 正確：while it rained。

questions.meaning: ｜聽見某動作正在發生，強調聽見過程。
questions.usage: ｜聽到某人或物持續發出的聲音。
questions.prompt: 半夜，她聽見門外有人唱歌。
options: She heard someone to sing outside.
optionExplanations: hear + object 後不加 to。
不能直接接過去式 sang。
不能直接接三單 sings。
正確：heard someone singing，強調過程。
questions.explanation: 正確：heard someone singing，強調過程。

questions.word: could + 原形：過去的可能／能力
questions.meaning: ｜could 在此可表示當時能夠或想像可能停留，需依語境判斷。
questions.usage: ｜談某個過去情境下有可能做到的事。
questions.prompt: 以前這間圖書館晚上開放，所以我能晚點走。
options: I could to stay at the library late.
I could stayed at the library late.
I could staying at the library late.
I could stay at the library late.
optionExplanations: could 後不加 to。
could 後不用 stayed。
could 後不用 staying。
正確：could stay。
questions.explanation: 正確：could stay。

questions.meaning: ｜祈使句常省略 you；但歌詞此處也可理解為承接前文的詩性省略。
questions.usage: ｜直接請別人做某事時。
questions.prompt: 攝影師請大家閉眼一秒。
options: Close your eyes for a second.
To close your eyes for a second.
Closing your eyes for a second.
Closed your eyes for a second.
optionExplanations: 正確：Close + 受詞。
單獨的 To close 是不定詞片語。
單獨的 Closing 不是標準祈使句。
祈使句動詞要用原形，不是 Closed。
questions.explanation: 正確：Close + 受詞。

questions.meaning: ｜「沒有任何事更……」；nothing 作單數主詞，接 is。
questions.usage: ｜強調某個選項對自己最有價值。
questions.prompt: 朋友認為和家人吃晚飯是最好的。
options: Nothing are better than dinner with my family.
Nothing better than dinner with my family is.
Nothing is better than dinner with my family.
Nothing is best than dinner with my family.
optionExplanations: nothing 為單數，應用 is。
語序不符合此比較句型。
正確：nothing is better than。
best 為最高級，不與 than 這樣搭配。
questions.explanation: 正確：nothing is better than。

questions.word: 反事實對比以外：時態 would 的不同用途
questions.meaning: ｜you’d 在此可理解為 you would；帶出以往反覆說過的事。
questions.usage: ｜描述以前某人習慣說的話。
questions.prompt: 回憶以前，每次下雨，爸爸都會說一樣的話。
options: The words Dad would say were funny.
The words Dad would saying were funny.
The words Dad would to say were funny.
The words Dad would said were funny.
optionExplanations: 正確：would say；words 後省略受詞關係代名詞。
would 後不直接用 saying。
would 後不加 to。
would 後用原形 say，不能用 said。
questions.explanation: 正確：would say；words 後省略受詞關係代名詞。

questions.word: threw + 受詞 + into + 地點
questions.meaning: ｜throw 的過去式 threw，into 表移入某處；原歌採強烈比喻。
questions.usage: ｜說某物被扔進容器；題目用安全的物品。
questions.prompt: 畫家把舊紙丟進回收箱。
options: The artist threw into the old paper the bin.
The artist threw the old paper into the bin.
The artist threw the old paper in to the bin.
The artist throwed the old paper into the bin.
optionExplanations: 受詞和地點順序錯。
正確：threw + object + into + place。
此處 in to 被錯誤拆開；要用 into。
throw 的過去式為 threw，不是 throwed。
questions.cue: I threw us into the flames
questions.explanation: 正確：threw + object + into + place。

questions.word: something + 動詞：不定代名詞作主詞
questions.meaning: ｜something 在文法上視為單數，即使指不明確的東西。
questions.usage: ｜某個不知名的事物發生變化時。
questions.prompt: 熄燈後，有東西掉到了地上。
options: Something falling on the floor after the lights went out.
Something fell on the floor after the lights went out.
Something were falling on the floor after the lights went out.
Something fall on the floor after the lights went out.
optionExplanations: 缺少限定動詞，不是完整句。
正確：something fell，主詞＋過去式。
something 作單數，不能搭配 were。
過去事件要用 fell；fall 不是過去式。
questions.explanation: 正確：something fell，主詞＋過去式。

questions.word: know + that + 子句：兩個 that
questions.meaning: ｜第一個 that 是連接詞，第二個 that 是「那件事」的指示代名詞。
questions.usage: ｜解釋自己明白某個時刻具有特殊意義。
questions.prompt: 最後一次看見舊家時，說「我知道那是最後一次」。
options: I knew that was that the last visit.
I knew that that my last visit was.
I knew that that is my last visit yesterday.
I knew that that was my last visit.
optionExplanations: 兩個 that 的功能與順序顛倒。
一般英語子句語序不自然。
昨天回顧過去用 was，is 不合時態。
正確：knew that（連接詞）that（代名詞）was...。
questions.cue: I knew that that was the last time
questions.explanation: 正確：knew that（連接詞）that（代名詞）was...。

questions.meaning: ｜sometimes 表示「有時」，常配現在簡單式談習慣。
questions.usage: ｜說明偶爾發生的日常情況。
questions.prompt: 一位攝影師有時清晨去拍照。
options: Sometimes she going out early to take photos.
Sometimes goes she out early to take photos.
Sometimes she goes out early to take photos.
Sometimes she go out early to take photos.
optionExplanations: 缺少 is。
標準陳述句不作這種倒裝。
正確：sometimes + 主詞 + 三單 goes。
主詞 she 的現在式要 goes。
questions.explanation: 正確：sometimes + 主詞 + 三單 goes。

questions.meaning: ｜名詞後的 you caught 修飾 heart；原本可有 that 作 caught 的受詞。
questions.usage: ｜指出某人曾經得到或接住的特定物品。
questions.prompt: 小孩找到媽媽昨天買的那本書。
options: The book Mom buying yesterday is here.
The book that Mom buy yesterday is here.
The book bought Mom yesterday is here.
The book Mom bought yesterday is here.
optionExplanations: Mom buying 非完整關係子句。
yesterday 需過去式 bought。
缺少合理的主詞與動詞關係。
正確：book (that) Mom bought。
questions.explanation: 正確：book (that) Mom bought。

questions.meaning: ｜現在某件事很可能正在發生；這裡 must 是推測。
questions.usage: ｜從線索推測他人現在在做什麼。
questions.prompt: 窗內有燈，爸爸大概還在工作。
options: Dad must be working because his light is on.
Dad must working because his light is on.
Dad must be work because his light is on.
Dad must to be working because his light is on.
optionExplanations: 正確：must be working，推測正在工作。
must 後缺 be。
be 後若表示進行狀態，要用 working。
must 後不加 to。
questions.explanation: 正確：must be working，推測正在工作。

questions.meaning: ｜強調「即使現在已如此」；even now 與 when 子句引出讓步感。
questions.usage: ｜事情已改變，但某種感受仍持續。
questions.prompt: 這座店關門了，他仍會想到它。
options: Even now, the shop to be closed, I still miss it.
Even now, when the shop has closed, I still miss it.
Even now the shop has closed, I still miss it.
Even now, when the shop closing, I still miss it.
optionExplanations: to be closed 不是完整時間子句。
正確：even now, when + 完整子句。
即使能理解，缺少 when 使此處連接不自然。
缺少限定動詞。
questions.cue: Even now, when we're already over
questions.explanation: 正確：even now, when + 完整子句。

questions.meaning: ｜歌詞使用較不典型的混合式；日常更自然是 can’t help looking 或 can’t stop myself from looking。
questions.usage: ｜辨認歌詞原樣，再學習標準表達，不把改寫冒充歌詞。
questions.prompt: 一看見小貓就忍不住笑，哪句是最自然的日常英文？
options: I can't help laughing when I see the kitten.
I can't help to laugh when I see the kitten.
I can't help myself looking to laugh at the kitten.
I can't stop myself from laugh when I see the kitten.
optionExplanations: 正確：can’t help laughing；這是日常標準改寫，不是歌詞原句。
can’t help 後接 -ing，不接 to laugh。
混合搭配不自然，looking to laugh 意思也偏離。
from 後接 laughing。
questions.cue: I can't help myself from looking for you
questions.explanation: 正確：can’t help laughing；這是日常標準改寫，不是歌詞原句。

questions.meaning: ｜look for 表示尋找；for 不可隨意省略。
questions.usage: ｜說明正在找某人或某物。
questions.prompt: 朋友在演唱會入口尋找妹妹。
options: He is looking for his sister near the gate.
He is looking after his sister near the gate.
He is looking at his sister near the gate.
He is looking his sister near the gate.
optionExplanations: 正確：look for = 尋找。
look after 表示照顧，不是尋找。
look at 表示看著，不是找。
looking 後缺 for，無法表尋找。
questions.explanation: 正確：look for = 尋找。

questions.word: 過去式 + while：分辨背景與主要事件
questions.meaning: ｜while 串起兩件同時進行的事；原歌以火與哭泣對照。
questions.usage: ｜描述某件活動進行時，另一件事也發生。
questions.prompt: 爸爸做飯時，孩子在畫畫。
options: The children drew while Dad cook yesterday.
The children drew while Dad cooked.
The children drew while Dad cooking.
The children drew while cooking Dad.
optionExplanations: yesterday 的過去事件應用 cooked。
正確：兩個過去式完整子句。
缺少 was。
Dad 的位置不對，意思變成「煮爸爸」。
questions.explanation: 正確：兩個過去式完整子句。

questions.word: the last time：特定的最後一次
questions.meaning: ｜last time 能指上一次，也能指最後一次；歌曲語境偏最後的告別。
questions.usage: ｜回憶再也沒有機會去的某地方。
questions.prompt: 一座老劇院關門前的最後一場演出。
options: It was the lastly time we watched a show there before it closed.
It was the last time we watched a show there before it closed.
It was last time that we watch a show there before it closed.
It was the last times we watched a show there before it closed.
optionExplanations: lastly 是副詞，不能這樣修飾 time。
正確：the last time + 過去事件。
在這語境下需要 the，且 watch 應用過去式。
這裡說一次，time 不用複數。
questions.explanation: 正確：the last time + 過去事件。

analysis.title: 翻譯細讀
analysis.note: 根據使用者 PDF 的雙語歌詞新增的編輯解說；比喻解讀均保留推論分寸。

items.title: 標題的矛盾意象
paragraphs: fire 與 rain 放在同一畫面，形成強烈而難以實現的動作意象。直譯保留衝突，讓讀者感受感情中的激烈與失控。
可把這個畫面理解為愛與痛苦交纏；這屬詮釋，歌詞沒有把雨和火逐一指定為單一象徵。

items.title: 心墜落與對方的動作
items.cue: I let it fall, my heart
paragraphs: my heart 延後出現，補明 it 的所指。中文可把「心」提早放入句子，讓指代清楚。
rose to claim it 的 to 表目的；claim 帶有取得、認領的意味。選用「接住」較柔和，會減弱原字的佔有色彩，分析時要說明這個取捨。

items.title: 身體力量與脆弱
items.translation: 雙手強壯，雙膝卻無力支撐
paragraphs: hands 與 knees 形成身體部位的對照。保留這組具體形象，可呈現外在力量與情感脆弱的並存。
falling to your feet 有屈服或拜倒的聯想；應結合前句雙膝無力閱讀，避免把它限制為普通跌倒。

items.title: 揭露不為人知的一面
items.translation: 你還有我從未認識的一面
paragraphs: side 在此指性格或行為的一面。「你的一邊」會令中文失去人物描寫的意思。
never knew 的反覆加重驚訝與失望。逐句翻譯仍須保留每次反覆，分析可以合併討論其效果。

items.title: 言語與操控
items.translation: 話語從不真實；遊戲總由你取勝
paragraphs: never 與 always 的絕對程度構成強烈控訴。中文應保留歌者的主觀語氣。
games 可在關係中理解為操控或捉弄。「遊戲」保留原比喻；「感情把戲」使中文更明確，也增加了詮釋。

items.title: 動作同時發生
items.cue: as I touched your face / while I cried
items.translation: 觸碰你臉龐時；流淚之際
paragraphs: as 與 while 在這兩處把動作放在同一時間畫面。中文可用「當……時」「一邊……一邊……」等自然句式。
不能僅憑連接詞把時間關係改寫成因果。觸碰、燃燒與哭泣的並置讓畫面更濃烈。

items.title: 火雨中的聲音
paragraphs: screaming out 比一般 saying 更激烈；「呼喊」或「嘶喊」要配合整段中文的強度。
it 的指代與前面的雨、燃燒畫面相連，帶有擬人效果。保留意象可避免過早把每個代詞改寫成明確人物。

items.title: 倒下、消逝與最後一次
paragraphs: something 刻意保留不確定。譯作「有些東西」或「某種感覺」各有取捨，後者把範圍收窄至感情。
若直接寫成某人死亡，會增加原句未有的具體事件。分析可討論信任或關係破裂的聯想，並標明推論。

items.title: 習慣仍留在身體裡
paragraphs: by 表示位置接近。把它譯成「走到門前」會改變原來的動作。
後文仍在尋找對方，呈現分開後殘留的期待。這是段落連貫性的讀法，單句翻譯仍應先交代動作與位置。

items.title: 無法停止尋找
items.cue: can’t help myself from looking for you
paragraphs: 整句表達難以控制的衝動。中文用「忍不住」能自然連接動作。
歌詞形式帶有口語和創作自由；正式寫作可練習 can’t help + -ing。教學應把歌曲原句與可遷移的標準句型分別說清楚。
